name: Youtu-Agent
description: Tencent Youtu Lab's agent framework with ready examples for research, data analysis and file tasks, tuned for open-source models.
whatItDoes: It runs configurable agents from the command line or a web UI and can generate a new agent's tools and config from a short interview. Aimed at developers and researchers who want strong results without closed models.
howItWorks: Built on the OpenAI Agents SDK conventions, agents are declared in YAML with toolkits such as search and file handling. A meta-agent script produces configs, which a chat script then runs against any OpenAI-compatible endpoint.

requirements.name: UTU_LLM_API_KEY
requirements.description: Key for the chat model, with UTU_LLM_BASE_URL, UTU_LLM_MODEL and UTU_LLM_TYPE
